root_cause: Port 8000 was occupied by an unrelated service; the project virtual environment also lacked a local uvicorn launcher even though declared dependencies were available through its linked environment.

health.evidence: FastAPI health returned the project model path, training-data path, and expected feature columns.

frontend_configuration.evidence: Frontend ML base URL is configurable with NEXT_PUBLIC_SPACE_WEATHER_API_URL and defaults to 127.0.0.1:8000.

frontend_live_request.evidence: Existing Next process could not be restarted with the alternate build-time URL because the shared .next/dev lock was held by another process.

fallback_behavior.evidence: Client source labels service success as trained_model, unavailable/no-input as unavailable, and retained fallback as heuristic_fallback.

recovery_behavior.evidence: The intended FastAPI service was started and returned a real production-artifact prediction after the unrelated port was avoided.

limitations: No credentials or database writes were used.
The production model artifact was loaded; no artifact was modified.
